description: Zoe Rasmussen aliases array: does it stay cumulative (union) across chapters, or can a later chapter's extraction overwrite it?
expected: aliases array remains superset of all previously-established spellings, i.e. still contains both diacritic and plain forms after ch5
notes: Post-ch2: aliases=["Zoe","Zoe"] (both spellings, single node, correct). Post-ch5 (all of ch1-5 landed): SAME single node but aliases=["Zoe"] only (diacritic form dropped). Root cause: graph-builder.ts upsertSingleEntity() exact-name MERGE path does destructive n += $updateProps overwrite of aliases instead of union; only the rename-detection branch unions safely. Filed as D-21. Node identity/no-duplicate guarantee (the ch2 PASS) is unaffected -- this is narrower: array contents lost, not entity resolution broken.
excerpt: diacritic form is the actual 'name', so canonical lookups still work; the alias-matching guarantee specifically (TEST-PLAN P3 line 38) is what's undercut. See defects.md D-21.
